run_low.source: RUN reads low below 0.8 V (RP2350 datasheet, Table 1683, VIL at IOVDD 3.3 V)

ss_low_u8.source: QSPI_SS reads low below 0.8 V at reset (RP2350 datasheet, Table 1683), so the RP2350 starts in its USB bootloader

ss_low_button.source: the same, with the BOOT button pressed

i_u8.source: the current U8 sinks stays under the 4 mA its VOL is stated at (SCES296AG)
